scope: Dedicated serial engine-only latency after project quality workers stopped; public inputs and newly created synthetic history only.
idle_confirmation: Project quality query workers had completed before serial measurement; no concurrent project benchmarks.
limits: Other Windows applications and OS scheduling are not isolated. This measures neither named-pipe/TSF latency nor live typing/game behavior. Filesystem caches are not cleared.
cold_scope: Constructor is a new Engine instance with imported Python modules and existing filesystem cache; first request recorded separately, not physical cold-disk startup.

measurement.percentiles: Nearest rank ceil(p*n), separate from constructor and first request.
measurement.snapshot_bias_control: Every timed call checks normalized input, raw length, mode and learning generation against the actual one-entry snapshot key; an untimed alternate sentinel evicts a match. No timed repeated-snapshot calls permitted.
